Rin: Your slide comments were rude and completely unhelpful.
Sam: Your whole draft was a mess, so spare me the lecture.
Rin: This is exactly why nobody wants feedback from you.
Sam: Fine, keep pretending your deck is precious.
Rin: I am done with the attitude.
Sam: Same. Send it to someone else next time.
Rin: Great, we finally agree on one thing: I will not ask you again.

extraction.mainQuestion: What substantive issue is being disputed?
caveats: The exchange is hostile, but it does not contain a substantive claim conflict to map.
